about_the_game:
🧰 Toolbox Tycoon – Build Your Trade Empire (BETA Testing)

Toolbox Tycoon is a fast-paced business management sim where you grow your own plumbing, HVAC, or electrical company from scratch. Hire staff, manage jobs, expand your fleet, and outmaneuver rival businesses in a dynamic city economy.

Whether you're fixing AC units or juggling loan repayments, every decision counts. Start small, scale up smart, and dominate the trades.

🛠️ Key Features

  • Auto Job Assignment – Build your team and get more jobs across the line! Time is money.

  • Dynamic City Map – Watch jobs spawn across town and dispatch your team in real-time.

  • Hiring System – Recruit apprentices, tradespeople, and masters with unique costs and capabilities.

  • Vehicle & Tool Management – Balance speed, reach, and operating costs as your jobs scale.

  • Competitor AI – Competing companies operate on the same map. Expand or buy them out.

  • Reputation System – Better jobs and loan rates come with a stronger name. (Coming soon)

  • Upgradeable Headquarters – Unlock new systems and benefits as you level up.

  • Realistic Trade Economy – Simulated cash flow, client demand, and growing complexity.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated GPU, 512 MB+
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Browser-based architecture. Runs on most modern systems.
